decision_summary: Interim Chief Shelby Parker recommended suspending the 2-year Flock pilot over privacy and public-records concerns; OPD asked Flock to deactivate the system on Dec 2, 2025 and staff hooded all 15 cameras on Dec 3. The cameras were later uninstalled and the pilot never resumed.
notes: City framed it as a suspension, but cameras were uninstalled Dec 2025 and the 24-month pilot term has lapsed with no renewal; treated as cancelled. Contract total $98,550 per The Olympian vs $90,000 on the order form (difference likely tax/fees); annual figure $45,000 taken from the order form.

decision_summary: Renton began a Flock trial in 2024 on a two-year contract at $88,240/yr with 24 cameras. After UW researchers found Border Patrol queries of Renton's system in 2025, the department locked down outside access. The city cycled the cameras off (Mar 31, 2026) and back on (Apr 21, 2026); on May 4, 2026 the council voted 4-3 to pause them again, and in Aug 2026 the cameras were physically covered while the council reviews the contract and researches third-party auditing.
